newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares poised to fall after Dow, France.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares poised to fall after Dow, France.

text.p: Danish share prices rose a little in early trade on Tuesday, but dealers were pessimistic about the outlook, seeing falls ahead following Wall Street and fears of the adverse affect on bonds of the French election and EMU fears.
"The early French election is hitting bonds, which in turn might well rub off on shares. The outlook is altogether rather negative," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had nonetheless gained 0.15 point to 153.61 at 0720 gmt, having closed unchanged on Monday.
